{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders, as they do not contribute to revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for duplicate orders
duplicates = sales_df['order_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Check for missing values in key columns
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check if channel is truly only two values
unique_channels = sales_df['channel'].unique()

# Check if customer_age has sentinel values
sentinel_age = (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()

# Summary
duplicates, missing_values, unique_channels, sentinel_age"}
